messages:
Jordan: quick preflight — planning to enable feature flag `geo-fallback-v2` for a tiny canary (5% EU -> NA fallback) at 16:10PT. can people validate the checklist below? :eyes:
Maya: ack. can you confirm stickiness TTL and canary audience definition? also need the concurrency guardrail value.
Jordan: suggested TTL 300s, canary cohort = users in EU region only, 5% by user_id hash. guardrail: max concurrent fallback streams = 50 per region.
Liam: question — which fallback model variant? quantized cheaper one or fp16? impacts latency/quality tradeoff.
Jordan: fallback model = `mistral-7b-q4_0` (quantized) for cost/latency. we have QA perf numbers that show median latency +60ms. if we see quality regression alert, we'll flip to `mistral-7b-fp16`.
Anya: add these ops checks before flip: 1) run smoke against /v1/generate with header `x-region: eu` for 10 sample prompts; 2) confirm KV cache warmup rate; 3) verify routing metrics dashboard link works. I'll own #1.
SRE-oncall: I'll tail routing logs and set an alert for error rate > 1% or p95 latency increase > 200ms over baseline. share the dashboard URL here when you have it.
Jordan: dashboard: https://redwood-internal.grafana.net/d/route/fallback?orgId=1&view=eu_canary (test link) — also running smoke now.
deploy-bot: deploy job started for flag `geo-fallback-v2` -> canary rollout config {"percent":5, "scope":"eu", "ttl":300}. CI smoke: queued. :robot_face:
Maya: quick code review ping: I approved the gateway change earlier (PR #4829). Jordan, make sure to include the new metric `fallback_model` in traces.
Jordan: noted. added trace tag. smoke results: 10/10 samples returned within expected quality bounds, median latency 420ms (baseline 360ms).
Anya: ran KV cache warmup check — miss rate dropped from 22% to 4% after warmup script. good.
SRE-oncall: monitoring configured. will escalate on slack if error > 1% or p95 delta > 200ms.
Liam: :thumbsup: if we see any prompt-level hallucination spikes we should pause and rollback to fp16; who will own the rollback?
Jordan: I'll own rollback. plan: flip `geo-fallback-v2` -> 0% and re-route to primary region. will announce in this thread.
Maya: one more guardrail: enable circuit-breaker for fallback path with 60s cooldown on open. ops already set that in gateway.
Jordan: thanks all — enabling now. will update when canary stabilizes. :white_check_mark:
